file: 307 Jailbreak Has a Guinness World Record.mp4

lines.t: This Roblox game is in the Guinness World Records. And it was made by just two people.

full.credit: Clips: Denis; KreekCraft; VeD_DeV (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: It's Jailbreak. Cops versus robbers. Escape the prison, rob the bank, and drive away.

full.credit: Clips: Denis; KreekCraft; VeD_DeV (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: In March 2020, it had over 3.3 million likes. The most likes for any game made in Roblox.

full.credit: Clips: Denis; KreekCraft; VeD_DeV (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Today it has over 8 billion visits. And people still break out of that prison every day.

full.credit: Clips: Denis; KreekCraft; VeD_DeV (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)
